component.name: Veskdora
component.summary: Custom Discord desktop app optimized for Fedora Workstation
Client desktop Discord personalizzato ottimizzato per Fedora Workstation

description.p: Veskdora is an open-source fork of Vesktop aiming to provide a fast, responsive, and seamless experience on Fedora Workstation.

ul.li: Vencord pre-installed for plugins and themes
Native Wayland support with fractional scaling (Ozone auto)
PipeWire screensharing with system audio sharing via Portal and venmic
GNOME Shell integration with safe close/quit behavior
Hardware video acceleration (VA-API) for low CPU usage
IBus input method editor integration on Wayland

description.p: Veskdora è un client desktop Discord personalizzato pensato per offrire un'esperienza fluida e reattiva su Fedora Workstation.

ul.li: Vencord preinstallato per plugin e temi personalizzati
Supporto nativo Wayland con scaling frazionario (Ozone auto)
Condivisione schermo e audio PipeWire tramite Desktop Portal e venmic
Accelerazione hardware video (VA-API) per ridurre il consumo di CPU
Integrazione IBus per il metodo di input su Wayland

description.p: Veskdora release optimized for Fedora Workstation with Wayland, PipeWire, and GNOME integration.
